verdict.rationale: Baseten's own docs say users can install its MCP servers so a coding agent can manage the Baseten workspace and search the docs, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented on the agent-setup page. As a platform rather than an agent, publishing an MCP server is a fair axis, and the product ships one. Missing for 10: details on the MCP tool surface, authentication and transport, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Install the Baseten skill and MCP servers so your coding agent can manage your Baseten workspace and search these docs.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.baseten.co/agent-setup
